target: Overall rank 1 scattering chain, internal rank 1 opaque shadow queries
description: Permute exhaustive cached ray-query invocations into screen-local 16x16 Morton order. Preserve original global pixel identity, sample seed, compact primary/source addresses, query flags, rays and integrator. Complete 16-row bands only; partial bands and non-row tiles retain scanline order. No new allocation or padded launch.

reference.principle: Map linearly indexed threads to pixels in Morton order within screen tiles; independent adaptation to the existing Vulkan ray-generation dispatch.

correctnessRequirement: Byte-identical HDR, including 1080p bottom 8-row tail, plus existing query/no-query, SPP, odd extent and low-budget matrices if target performance improves.
